Max 517.49 m (raw source int16 max 518) at x=426387.5 y=4586002.5 (2.11908E 41.42221N). Verified: this point lies inside the OSM footprint of the Temple Expiatori del Sagrat Cor (way 486759610) on the Tibidabo summit. Nominal summit is 512 m, so the +5.5 m is consistent with the temple platform or structure in the DTM or a source artefact. It is not a reprojection error, because the raw tile reads 518 too. The cause beyond that is not verified.

124 cells below 0 m (min -7.0 m; the raw source tile contains -7, so these values are not created by the processing). All of them lie in the Zona Franca / port area, bbox x 425437-428707, y 4575837-4577772. The minimum is next to Passeig de la Zona Franca. Cause (dock basins, excavations or source artefact) is NOT verified. Flag these cells for review before any simulation.

datasets.name: IDW rainfall interpolation helper (src/bcnflood/data/rain_idw.py)
datasets.access: python: bcnflood.data.rain_idw.idw_point(x, y, stations, values, power=2.0, k=4, coincident_tol_m=1.0)
datasets.units: same as input values (e.g. mm per 30 min)
datasets.method: w_i = d_i^-p / sum d_j^-p over the k nearest stations with valid values (default p=2, k=4). Missing values are excluded and the weights renormalised. All missing -> value None (never 0). A station within 1 m returns its own value (mean if several).
warnings: ESTIMATE: only 4 gauges; ignores orography (D5 at 410 m) and storm structure
Results stay within the range of the stations used; it cannot represent local maxima
Input values for 3-7 Oct are unvalidated (G1)
